gR8f42PYQl.evidence: Four methods across harnesses on general and coding tasks, sixteen evolved agents, repeated evaluations, controlled agent expansion, component interventions and admission replays.
gR8f42PYQl.claimed_gains: All sixteen evolved agents gain previously uncovered tasks while losing previously covered ones, and in one general-task case reliability rises by 5.2 points despite losing ten covered tasks; EvoAudit is said to achieve the best performance (no number stated).

mYfMacZ4WG.one_liner: Few-step camera-controlled video re-rendering via geometry-feature alignment, MeanFlow fine-tuning and on-policy flow map distillation.
mYfMacZ4WG.problem: Multi-step generative rendering models show sampling-step-dependent camera control, a discretization error that raises denoising trajectory curvature and hinders step distillation.
mYfMacZ4WG.method: Representation Transformation and Alignment (RETA) aligns hidden source-video representations with target-video features from a frozen visual geometry model. The model is then fine-tuned with the MeanFlow objective on the lower-curvature trajectory and distilled with on-policy flow map distillation to correct self-rollout errors.
mYfMacZ4WG.key_idea: Align hidden source-video features with a frozen geometry model's target-view features to make camera control step-consistent, lowering trajectory curvature before MeanFlow training and distillation.
mYfMacZ4WG.evidence: Extensive experiments (details truncated in the abstract) indicating that RETA, MeanFlow and on-policy flow map distillation play complementary roles in few-step generative rendering.
mYfMacZ4WG.claimed_gains: Matches multi-step baselines in video quality and geometric consistency at 25× lower sampling cost while achieving superior camera controllability.

WeKDI37cN1.one_liner: Reweights teacher timestamp candidates by tIoU utility under fixed-suffix interventions to build corrective on-policy distillation targets for temporal video grounding.
WeKDI37cN1.problem: Video-OPD updates stay centered on the student's sampled token and do not turn teacher-supported timestamp alternatives that could improve localization into training targets.
WeKDI37cN1.method: At each student-induced timestamp state, Video-OPD++ evaluates teacher-supported candidate actions with annotation-derived tIoU utilities under fixed-suffix interventions and reweights the teacher prior into a corrective distribution. This distribution replaces the sampled-action reward at timestamp positions, with a discounted future residual preserving feedback from later token discrepancies.
WeKDI37cN1.key_idea: Score teacher-supported timestamp alternatives by tIoU with the suffix fixed, and reweight the teacher prior into a corrective distribution used as the distillation signal at timestamp tokens.
WeKDI37cN1.evidence: Analysis that for more than three quarters of student trajectories the teacher support contains a tIoU-improving alternative, and experiments on three temporal video grounding benchmarks (results truncated in the abstract).

MeVsuBHOpo.one_liner: Selects VLA-aligned VLM data with a learned proximity estimator to mid-train VLMs before VLA fine-tuning.
MeVsuBHOpo.problem: Most VLAs are built from off-the-shelf VLMs not adapted to the embodied domain, and VLA data occupy compact regions largely separated from the broader VLM data distribution.
MeVsuBHOpo.method: A lightweight learnable proximity estimator selects the most VLA-aligned candidates from a large VLM pool to form EmbodiedMidtrain-1M, which is used to mid-train the VLM before downstream VLA fine-tuning.
MeVsuBHOpo.key_idea: Rank VLM data by a learned proximity to VLA data and mid-train on the closest samples to give VLA fine-tuning a better initialization.
MeVsuBHOpo.evidence: Simulated robot manipulation benchmarks and real-world tasks across VLM backbones and VLA action heads, plus analysis of training dynamics and data-selection behavior.
MeVsuBHOpo.claimed_gains: not stated; the abstract reports consistent VLA gains across backbones and action heads without numbers.

zEvJmHCOUL.one_liner: Black-box attack that learns which intent-preserving reformulations bypass activation-steering safety defenses in vision-language models.
zEvJmHCOUL.problem: Activation-steering defenses for VLMs may not stay effective when the same harmful request is expressed in alternative textual, visual or joint forms.
zEvJmHCOUL.method: SteerProbe is an output-only black-box attack that learns to select effective reformulations for unseen requests from a shared calibration budget. A local analysis gives a sufficient condition under which a reformulation crosses a surrogate safety margin despite any admissible steering correction.
zEvJmHCOUL.key_idea: Learn from a small calibration budget which intent-preserving textual, visual or joint reformulations to apply per request so the request escapes the steering correction.
zEvJmHCOUL.evidence: Three VLM backbones, two benchmarks and three steering defenses, with 500 total calibration queries per endpoint and benchmark.
zEvJmHCOUL.claimed_gains: Raises the average Harmful Rate from 7.43% to 18.36% across defended settings.

7EtSASfnVn.one_liner: Benchmark, data engine and modality-factored self-distillation for audio-visual joint reasoning in omni-modal models.
7EtSASfnVn.problem: Existing benchmarks, training data and learning methods treat audio, vision and language independently, leaving audio-visual joint reasoning poorly evaluated and insufficiently elicited.
7EtSASfnVn.method: OmniReasoningBench requires both audio and visual evidence, the OmniQA data engine builds evidence-grounded QA with time-stamped clue chains (yielding OmniReasoning-SFT-112K and OmniReasoning-RL-19K), and Modality-Factored Self-Distillation (MFSD) scores sampled responses under modality-specific clue contexts for token-level credit assignment.
7EtSASfnVn.key_idea: Evaluate each sampled response under modality-specific clue contexts to separate individual clue contributions and cross-modal interactions for token-level credit assignment in on-policy self-distillation.
7EtSASfnVn.evidence: OmniReasoningBench has 1,150 multiple-choice and open-ended questions across two tasks, and the trained OmniReasoning-30B-A3B model is evaluated on OmniVideoBench and a second benchmark whose name is truncated.
7EtSASfnVn.claimed_gains: OmniReasoning-30B-A3B achieves 50.0% on OmniVideoBench and 42.5% on a second benchmark (name truncated in the abstract).

ZFCw6a3QKH.one_liner: Weights privileged teacher corrections by agreement between partial and full evidence, shrinking poorly supported targets toward a prompt-only teacher.
ZFCw6a3QKH.problem: In privileged distillation of few-step video generators, the largest evaluated evidence budget gives lower mean generation scores and motion activity than an intermediate budget, and teacher corrections vary across references.
ZFCw6a3QKH.method: Mode-Calibrated Privileged Distillation (MCPD) compares corrections from a progressively enlarged evidence subset and the full selected budget within a single continuation, and weights the full correction per token by directional agreement and normalized displacement. Poorly supported targets move toward the teacher prediction conditioned only on the prompt and first frame; PITV is an offline measure of teacher-correction variance.
ZFCw6a3QKH.key_idea: Test support within one continuation by comparing partial and full-evidence corrections, and weight each token's full correction by directional agreement and normalized displacement.
ZFCw6a3QKH.evidence: 4-step Wan2.2 and 8-step LongCat-Video with VBench-I2V, controls on Wan2.2 that match residual energy or mix teacher queries with fixed weights, and a comparison with adapted DFD.
ZFCw6a3QKH.claimed_gains: Improves VBench-I2V Total Score by 0.6–0.9 points over timestep-dependent scalar shrinkage on 4-step Wan2.2 and 8-step LongCat-Video.

h9oDIdD6ok.one_liner: Long-horizon audio-visual generation with long- and short-term memory, a goal-driven memory agent and error-recycling training.
h9oDIdD6ok.problem: Coherent long-form audio-visual narratives need preserved character and scene identities and continuity of motion and sound across shots, which requires linked training annotations and memory that retrieves useful context from an imperfect generation history.
h9oDIdD6ok.method: They build CineLong-709K (708,794 videos, about 20k hours, up to 148 seconds) with global-to-local annotations, and CineLong combines long-term memory for characters, voices and scenes with short-term memory for ongoing actions and speech. At inference a Goal-Driven Memory Agent (GDMA) selects relevant history chunks and keyframes, and Audio-Visual Error Recycling (AVER) injects model-derived visual and acoustic errors into memory during training.
h9oDIdD6ok.key_idea: Select relevant historical chunks and keyframes from the target prompt with a memory agent, and train with model-derived audio-visual errors injected into memory to tolerate imperfect history.
h9oDIdD6ok.evidence: Evaluation on CineLong-Bench against existing baselines for subject and background recall, cross-chunk audio continuity and script adherence.
h9oDIdD6ok.claimed_gains: not stated; the abstract says CineLong outperforms baselines on subject and background recall, cross-chunk audio continuity and script adherence without numbers.

UtSpCnqHk8.one_liner: Predicts diffusion-LLM request cost as a probability surface over output blocks and denoising steps from the prompt alone.
UtSpCnqHk8.problem: Common cost proxies for dLLM serving fail: output length ignores that one forward pass can unmask multiple tokens, and denoising-step count ignores heterogeneous per-step costs.
UtSpCnqHk8.method: The Denoising Workload Surface (DWS) keeps the two-dimensional block-step structure of block-autoregressive generation as a probability surface that weights heterogeneous per-step costs. A lightweight prompt-only predictor trained coarse-to-fine predicts it and runs on a single CPU core.
UtSpCnqHk8.key_idea: Keep the block-by-step execution structure as a probability surface weighting per-step costs, decoupling request behavior from deployment-specific cost factors so the predictor transfers across hardware.
UtSpCnqHk8.evidence: Real-world serving experiments (details truncated in the abstract); the predictor is said to transfer across hardware configurations without retraining.

3nSV2brMqb.one_liner: Benchmark where multimodal agent players pursue long-horizon objectives inside video world models across 171 scenarios.
3nSV2brMqb.problem: Interactive world models are hard to compare fairly because the action sequence for the same objective varies across models, making fixed action-conditioned evaluation unsuitable.
3nSV2brMqb.method: PlayWorld has multimodal Agent Players interact with world models toward specified objectives in 171 scenarios, scoring geometry consistency, interaction fidelity, out-of-sight evolution and insight evolution, plus basic video quality and controllability metrics.
3nSV2brMqb.key_idea: Replace fixed action scripts with agent players that pursue a specified long-horizon objective through interaction, then score the resulting rollout along four dimensions.
3nSV2brMqb.evidence: Experiments across nine existing world models (results truncated in the abstract).

DmH3HpzlV6.one_liner: Bottom-up autoregressive model generating geometry, articulation and physical attributes via separate part and kinematic-link levels.
DmH3HpzlV6.problem: Generated 3D assets are mostly static, and existing approaches recover articulation after geometry generation or use the same granularity for geometric parts and kinematic links, hurting fine detail or compact physical structure.
DmH3HpzlV6.method: A bottom-up autoregressive framework models fine-grained geometric components and rigid kinematic links as distinct but connected levels, jointly generating geometry, articulation and simulation-relevant physical attributes including joint dynamics. It is co-trained on a scalable data pipeline plus large-scale part-aware geometry and simulation-ready assets.
DmH3HpzlV6.key_idea: Model geometric parts and rigid kinematic links as two connected levels in one autoregressive sequence so fine detail and compact physical structure are generated jointly.
DmH3HpzlV6.evidence: Experiments on geometric fidelity, articulation accuracy and simulation executability, plus manipulation policies trained on trajectories from generated assets and transferred to real-world objects.

YoY3Gk7Syu.one_liner: Trains a lightweight RoI proposal network with region-level RL, scoring regions by answer-likelihood change when removed from a frozen MLLM.
YoY3Gk7Syu.problem: Raising resolution for fine-grained perception in MLLMs inflates vision-encoding and prefilling costs, while attention-distilled proposal networks inherit noisy targets and discrete region choices cannot be supervised by answer faithfulness directly.
YoY3Gk7Syu.method: Vision-RL2 treats coherent regions as actions in region-level reinforcement learning, and a frozen MLLM reader scores each region by how its removal changes the answer likelihood. Complementary subtractive and additive objectives suppress distracting proposals and recover missing evidence.
YoY3Gk7Syu.key_idea: Score each proposed region by how removing it changes a frozen MLLM's answer likelihood and use that as the reward, with subtractive and additive objectives.
YoY3Gk7Syu.evidence: A controlled diagnostic shows localization tolerates roughly 3 to 4 times stronger token compression than recognition; the method's own results are truncated in the abstract.

4mnt3eA9ir.one_liner: Benchmark and training data using MLLMs as online guides that verify and correct a frozen planner's trajectories in closed-loop driving.
4mnt3eA9ir.problem: Open-loop judgments do not show whether MLLM action-grounded reasoning helps closed-loop driving.
4mnt3eA9ir.method: ActionGuide-Bench evaluates MLLMs on Evidence Grounding, Consequence Prediction, Trajectory Verification and Corrective Guidance, and in closed loop as an online guide to a frozen base planner. ActionGuide-Train links decision-critical contexts with alternative ego behaviors, execution outcomes and corrective actions through rule-based synthesis and planner rollouts.
4mnt3eA9ir.key_idea: Cast the MLLM as an online guide that verifies proposed trajectories and gives corrective guidance to a frozen planner, so its judgments help without retraining the motion policy.
4mnt3eA9ir.evidence: Evaluation of leading MLLMs at the action-grounded and closed-loop levels; stated findings include that pretrained open-source MLLMs can already improve closed-loop driving as online guides (remaining findings truncated).

x04RELIF6P.one_liner: Benchmark of 140 Godot game-generation tasks scored by replayed gameplay and rubric-guided multimodal judging.
x04RELIF6P.problem: End-to-end game generation requires scripts, scenes, assets, rendering and runtime interactions to jointly produce coherent gameplay inside an engine, unlike traditional coding tasks, and needs an engine-grounded evaluation.
x04RELIF6P.method: End-to-end game generation is formalized as producing a complete playable artifact. GameCraft-Bench has 140 Godot tasks across 15 game families and evaluates executable gameplay through replayed demonstrations and rubric-guided multimodal judging under three desiderata: Engine Grounding, Artifact Completeness and Interactive Verification.
x04RELIF6P.key_idea: Evaluate generated games by replaying demonstrated player interactions in the engine and scoring them with task-specific rubrics through a multimodal judge.
x04RELIF6P.evidence: Evaluation of frontier coding agents on 140 Godot tasks across 15 game families.
x04RELIF6P.claimed_gains: The strongest agent achieves only 68.44% and most agents score below 40%.

yECLVPwR3R.one_liner: Red-team benchmark for multimodal-to-audio-video generation and PerceptGuard, an omni-modal guard trained on rationale generation and safety classification.
yECLVPwR3R.problem: Existing generation-safety benchmarks give limited coverage of multimodal input combinations and obscured attack intents for audio-video generators.
yECLVPwR3R.method: Multi2AV-Safety contains 11,024 attack instances over all 11 non-singleton T/I/A/V conditioning configurations, 4 attack-intent categories and 5 harm categories. PerceptGuard integrates compositional-risk and attack-intent supervision, jointly training rationale generation and safety classification so a safety head can predict efficiently.
yECLVPwR3R.key_idea: Jointly train rationale generation and safety classification with compositional-risk and attack-intent supervision to learn shared risk representations feeding an efficient safety head.
yECLVPwR3R.evidence: Evaluation of four multimodal-conditioned audio-video generators and eight safety guards on the benchmark.
yECLVPwR3R.claimed_gains: not stated; the TL;DR claims best multimodal safety detection for PerceptGuard without numbers.

fWcZKXCvlX.one_liner: Co-designs morphology and control by exploring a compact latent Morphogene that jointly conditions body and policy generation per limb.
fWcZKXCvlX.problem: Existing co-design methods use separate networks for morphology and control coupled only through a shared task objective, limiting explicit high-level coordination.
fWcZKXCvlX.method: Morphogene is a compact latent blueprint that, through AdaConcat, conditions morphology and control generation at the limb level. GeCode explores Morphogene space, anchoring local design regions and moving anchors toward promising regions with performance-guided updates.
fWcZKXCvlX.key_idea: Condition both body and controller on one shared latent blueprint and search in that latent space with local anchors plus performance-guided anchor updates.
fWcZKXCvlX.evidence: Experiments across diverse 2D and 3D co-design tasks against existing methods.
fWcZKXCvlX.claimed_gains: not stated; the abstract reports faster convergence and higher final performance without numbers.

NOH2A7lGJk.one_liner: Selects historical experts to distill from using functional probes of which knowledge the student is forgetting, for continual MLLM learning.
NOH2A7lGJk.problem: In continual on-policy distillation for MLLMs, preserving experts does not ensure effective historical supervision because capabilities are exposed unevenly and general OPD ignores what is being forgotten.
NOH2A7lGJk.method: RESPOND probes current trajectories to supervise capabilities that are vulnerable in the student and observable through their experts, consolidating with bounded historical-teacher queries per update.
NOH2A7lGJk.key_idea: Probe student trajectories to find vulnerable capabilities that experts can reveal, and distill only from those experts on those trajectories under a bounded query budget.
NOH2A7lGJk.evidence: Eight sequential tasks and two OOD benchmarks across three backbones, including Qwen3.5-4B.
NOH2A7lGJk.claimed_gains: Improves final overall averages by 2.25–2.91 points over the strongest competing continual methods across three backbones, and on Qwen3.5-4B reduces average forgetting by 50.2% and 69.7% relative to two vanilla continual OPD baselines.

r9EgYOUmRo.one_liner: Training-free VideoLLM acceleration combining temporal merging, request-aware spatial pruning and attention compensation during prefill.
r9EgYOUmRo.problem: Processing many visual tokens makes VideoLLM inference slow, and existing token compression methods overlook compression-induced attention distortion that can hurt accuracy.
r9EgYOUmRo.method: Position-wise temporal merging reduces temporal redundancy at each spatial position, request-aware spatial pruning selects tokens by visual salience and request relevance, and sparsity-aware attention compensation mitigates attention distortion during LLM prefill. Triton kernels and a FlashAttention-compatible design support it.
r9EgYOUmRo.key_idea: Compensate for the attention distortion caused by merged and pruned visual tokens during prefill, instead of only choosing which tokens to drop.
r9EgYOUmRo.evidence: Three VideoLLMs and five video understanding benchmarks, with latency measured on one NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU.
r9EgYOUmRo.claimed_gains: Preserves 95.3–99.2% of full-token average accuracy at 10% visual token retention, with 2.6–3.2× TTFT speedups and up to 1.25× end-to-end throughput with 1K-token outputs.

SIlCRKTkkb.one_liner: Unified audio-video generation and editing via unimodal-first progressive training and modality-decoupled noise schedulers.
SIlCRKTkkb.problem: Paired audio-video corpora are scarce, so methods spend capacity relearning single-branch skills, and a single shared noise schedule ignores the different information density of video and audio and leaves asymmetric workflows untrained.
SIlCRKTkkb.method: UniAVC first trains each branch on unimodal data to full generative and editing competence, then uses paired data for cross-modal correspondence. Modality-decoupled schedulers warp the noise schedule independently from a shared timestep.
SIlCRKTkkb.key_idea: Train each modality branch on unimodal data first, then on paired data, and warp each modality's noise schedule independently from a shared timestep.
SIlCRKTkkb.evidence: The abstract is truncated before the experiments; no benchmarks or numbers are stated.

RxwKuiYnHn.one_liner: Class of adaptive randomized Shapley estimators with different control variates whose errors can be compared without ground truth.
RxwKuiYnHn.problem: Computing Shapley values needs exponentially many queries, and no existing randomized approximation algorithm consistently outperforms the others, so without ground truth it is unclear which estimate is most accurate.
RxwKuiYnHn.method: They introduce provably adaptive randomized algorithms that keep the best-known query complexity with linear memory, differ in their choice of control variates, and generalize linear-memory KernelSHAP. All estimates come from the same sampled subsets, which lets the potentially best one be identified without ground-truth Shapley values.
RxwKuiYnHn.key_idea: Run several control-variate estimators on one shared sequence of sampled subsets and select the one with the best estimated error, without access to true Shapley values.
RxwKuiYnHn.evidence: Provable adaptivity and query-complexity guarantees; empirical results are not visible in the truncated abstract.

FumWWB5wLP.one_liner: Initializes a trainable Wiener prediction path and coefficient interfaces with data statistics to ease pixel-space velocity learning.
FumWWB5wLP.problem: Learning velocity fields directly in pixel space is difficult and slow.
FumWWB5wLP.method: Wiener-informed Decoding (WiD) combines a trainable Wiener prediction path with coefficient interfaces that inject features into the native decoder and return its predicted coefficient corrections, all initialized with data statistics and trained jointly under the original pixel-space velocity objective.
FumWWB5wLP.key_idea: Initialize a Wiener prediction path and coefficient interfaces from second-order image statistics, using them both for direct prediction and to organize decoder computation without modifying native blocks.
FumWWB5wLP.evidence: Experiments across model scales, decoder architectures and resolutions, on class-conditional and text-to-image generation, including PixelDiT-XL on ImageNet 256×256.
FumWWB5wLP.claimed_gains: PixelDiT-XL with WiD reaches FID 1.53 after 500 epochs on ImageNet 256×256, comparable quality to PixelDiT with 37.5% fewer training (rest truncated in the abstract).

YK8lGF8TfQ.one_liner: Feed-forward flow-matching model that tracks a known mesh from monocular video by generating 4D vertex trajectories.
YK8lGF8TfQ.problem: Tracking the 4D motion of a known mesh from monocular video is hard, and flow matching in vertex trajectory space faces a noise-to-vertex transport ambiguity.
YK8lGF8TfQ.method: FoMo formulates tracking as generative 4D morphing natively in 4D vertex trajectory space with flow matching, and resolves the noise-to-vertex transport ambiguity through a dual-geometry architecture.
YK8lGF8TfQ.key_idea: Generate vertex trajectories directly with flow matching, using a dual-geometry architecture to resolve noise-to-vertex transport ambiguity.
YK8lGF8TfQ.evidence: Mesh and skeletal tracking comparisons with prior and specialized methods, plus generalization to in-the-wild and synthetic videos; datasets are not named.
YK8lGF8TfQ.claimed_gains: not stated; the abstract says FoMo outperforms prior mesh trackers and specialized skeletal trackers without numbers.

CU4qmjUYtR.one_liner: Streaming reference-to-video generation that lets references enter or leave mid-generation via a value gate and rollout-depth error banks.
CU4qmjUYtR.problem: Reference-to-video generation fixes the reference set before generation, but subjects enter and leave mid-shot, history frames override newly inserted references, and error rises and accumulates at the interaction chunk.
CU4qmjUYtR.method: A reference reflective value gate reconstructs each history token from the references and subtracts the reference-explainable identity from its value, leaving the attention map untouched. A virtual rollout error chain adds history-error banks indexed by rollout depth, approximating error accumulation at one forward pass per iteration.
CU4qmjUYtR.key_idea: Subtract reference-explainable identity from history token values rather than altering attention, and approximate error accumulation using history-error banks indexed by rollout depth.
CU4qmjUYtR.evidence: An SR2V benchmark with diverse events of subject entry and exit (results truncated in the abstract).

cZLSlieb3M.one_liner: Bidirectional context model for semantic occupancy compression: semantics condition geometry coding and reconstructed geometry conditions finer-scale semantic coding.
cZLSlieb3M.problem: Dense 3D semantic occupancy needs large bandwidth, and using semantic labels as context for geometry coding is underexplored when labels are treated as ordinary point attributes.
cZLSlieb3M.method: Early-decoded semantics inform subsequent geometry coding through label relative spatial context and semantic category context, combined with causal geometry context. Reconstructed geometry's local context is combined with the available semantic context to predict labels at finer scales.
cZLSlieb3M.key_idea: Code geometry and semantics in alternating directions so each provides entropy-model context for the other.
cZLSlieb3M.evidence: The abstract is truncated before the experiments; no datasets or numbers are stated.

x0TKaMUu1W.one_liner: Inference-time framework that builds, validates and maintains explicit belief states for LLM agents and recovers from stalled progress.
x0TKaMUu1W.problem: How LLM agents organize interaction history into memory does not ensure a coherent understanding of the current world, leaving them acting without progress (Belief Trapping).
x0TKaMUu1W.method: PoS constructs explicit belief states combining a current world-state estimate with unresolved task requirements, validates their consistency, monitors progress to detect Belief Trapping, and applies recovery tailored to the trapping pattern and the type of unresolved requirement.
x0TKaMUu1W.key_idea: Replace history retention with an explicit belief state of world estimate plus unresolved requirements, validated for consistency, with recovery triggered by detected lack of progress.
x0TKaMUu1W.evidence: Four benchmarks spanning execution and diagnosis with three LLM backbones, plus ablations and context-scaling experiments.
x0TKaMUu1W.claimed_gains: not stated; the abstract reports the highest overall performance on every benchmark with all three backbones without numbers.

NTM87A7Gds.one_liner: Label-limited EEG foundation model adaptation using cohort-level supervision, confidence-aware pseudo-labels and a prototype-conditioned adapter on frozen models.
NTM87A7Gds.problem: With only a few labeled subjects, noisy limited supervision mismatches the highly plastic parameters of EEG foundation models, causing overconfident miscalibration, transient optimization collapse and disruption of pretrained representations.
NTM87A7Gds.method: SCOPE builds cohort-level external supervision, derives confidence-aware pseudo-labels to select reliable unlabeled samples, and adds ProAdapter, a lightweight prototype-conditioned adapter that modulates frozen EFMs to preserve pretrained representations.
NTM87A7Gds.key_idea: Keep the foundation model frozen and modulate it with a prototype-conditioned adapter trained on cohort-level supervision and confidence-filtered pseudo-labels.
NTM87A7Gds.evidence: 60 adaptation settings spanning 6 tasks, 5 EFM backbones and 5%–100% labeled subject ratios.
NTM87A7Gds.claimed_gains: In label-limited settings, SCOPE outperforms full fine-tuning by 4.6 multiclass Kappa and 4.4 binary PRAUC points on average.

p6thn2PhEo.one_liner: Training-free sampler reuses the previous replan's denoising trajectory as initialization for a parallel fixed-point solve in flow-based robot policies.
p6thn2PhEo.problem: Standard samplers for flow-based robot policies denoise sequentially for each action chunk and discard the solver trajectory at every replan, though consecutive control cycles solve closely related problems.
p6thn2PhEo.method: After an action prefix is executed, RePIC shifts the cached trajectory to the new horizon and re-aligns it to fresh noise with a closed-form correction that preserves the clean-action endpoint and needs no network evaluation. The pretrained velocity network then refines all transferred states under the new observation through batched fixed-point updates on the original integration grid.
p6thn2PhEo.key_idea: Shift and re-noise the cached denoising trajectory in closed form, then refine all states in parallel by fixed-point updates, converting an accurate initialization into fewer sequential network calls.
p6thn2PhEo.evidence: Fast-WAM on RoboTwin2.0 and LIBERO, π0.5 and GR00T N1.5 without retraining, and a physical robot experiment.
p6thn2PhEo.claimed_gains: On Fast-WAM, sequential calls per chunk drop from 10 to 2.2-2.6 and latency from 578 to 218ms on RoboTwin2.0 (2.66×) and from 564 to 205ms on LIBERO (2.75×) at comparable success, RePIC-Flash reaches 5.71×, π0.5 and GR00T N1.5 speed up by 1.14× and 1.68×, and physical-robot success is 77.5% versus 66.3% for the original.

rEbx1TSx9H.one_liner: Restricts CTC alignment computation to the batch's target-token vocabulary subset, keeping full-vocabulary normalization for exact loss and gradients.
rEbx1TSx9H.problem: Conventional CTC materializes frame-by-vocabulary activations, making training with native LLM vocabularies prohibitively memory-intensive.
rEbx1TSx9H.method: Pruned CTC computes alignments over the union of target tokens and blank in a batch while retaining full-vocabulary normalization, with a proof of exact equivalence to full-vocabulary CTC in loss and gradients. LLM-CTC builds on it to adapt pretrained LLMs for non-autoregressive ASR with causal attention and native vocabularies, and extends to bounded-history streaming.
rEbx1TSx9H.key_idea: Every valid CTC alignment uses only target tokens and blank, so restricting alignment computation to their batch union is exact while memory stops scaling with vocabulary size.
rEbx1TSx9H.evidence: A Zipformer-M encoder with a 180K vocabulary, three corpora, and GigaSpeech across six Qwen3 model sizes from 0.6B to 32B.
rEbx1TSx9H.claimed_gains: Reduces full-step memory by 5.1× with only 17% step-time overhead, matches standard CTC accuracy across three corpora, and keeps LLM-CTC within 7% relative WER (comparison truncated in the abstract).

vMGUOWgGQJ.one_liner: Sparse-first inference engine with a lifecycle contract supporting 15 KV-cache methods and cross-request Chain Cache and Prefix Cache Pruning.
vMGUOWgGQJ.problem: Long-context LLM agents inflate KV-cache memory and slow decoding, and engines tied to specific layouts or workflows struggle to support heterogeneous sparse cache representations, metadata and update rules while sharing scheduling and cache reuse.
vMGUOWgGQJ.method: SparseEngine uses a shared lifecycle contract with fine-grained hooks and method-owned cache management across 15 cache methods (dynamic sparsity, KV eviction, compression, quantization). Chain Cache resumes eviction-based methods across turns from compacted KV and metadata, and Prefix Cache Pruning reclaims KV from application-selected regions while preserving logical-prefix matching.
vMGUOWgGQJ.key_idea: Let each sparse method own its KV representation and updates behind a shared lifecycle contract, so scheduling, capacity management and cross-request cache reuse stay common.
vMGUOWgGQJ.evidence: Evaluations show it closely preserves reference-method quality, with throughput measured on 128K-token inputs against vanilla vLLM (remaining results truncated in the abstract).
vMGUOWgGQJ.claimed_gains: On 128K-token inputs it delivers 9.8–12.1× vanilla vLLM's aggregate decode throughput with KV eviction (rest truncated in the abstract).

jOwEQxTr4E.one_liner: Subject-driven video generation that decouples video and reference processing with domain-aware AdaLN and anchored reference RoPE for cross-domain use.
jOwEQxTr4E.problem: Existing subject-driven video methods optimize in-domain fidelity by indiscriminately preserving reference appearance, limiting flexibility in real-to-fantasy, fantasy-to-real and mixed scenarios.
jOwEQxTr4E.method: Domain-MoT decouples video and reference processing with Domain-aware AdaLN for reference images, and STRA-RoPE temporally anchors reference tokens and spatially organizes them with subject-aware offsets. Cross-Pair Consistent Loss aligns velocity predictions across reference sets in bidirectional training, and the model is extended to streaming autoregressive generation.
jOwEQxTr4E.key_idea: Process references in a separate domain-aware branch with anchored RoPE positions, and align velocity predictions across reference sets to suppress subject-irrelevant features.
jOwEQxTr4E.evidence: The abstract is truncated before the experiments; no datasets, baselines or numbers are stated.

x6oIXJYZ7g.one_liner: Probe-based module routes each reasoning step through attention-head pathways matched to the inferred logic state, plugging into existing reasoning paradigms.
x6oIXJYZ7g.problem: Reasoning paradigms prescribe external strategies but do not check whether the model's internal computation pathway matches the dynamic reasoning logic state, limiting their potential.
x6oIXJYZ7g.method: LoTR identifies dynamic logic states from internal information transfer, couples them with attention-head pathway patterns, and uses a lightweight probe to infer the current logic-state mixture and softly route the corresponding pathway.
x6oIXJYZ7g.key_idea: Infer the current logic-state mixture with a lightweight probe on internal activations and softly route attention-head pathways that match it.
x6oIXJYZ7g.evidence: 3 backbones, 10 benchmarks and 8 reasoning paradigms, compared with 4 inference-time intervention baselines.
x6oIXJYZ7g.claimed_gains: Improves matched accuracy by 3.60% on average and 5.37% on Llama with only +0.15% completion tokens and lower latency on 2 backbones, and outperforms the mean of 4 inference-time intervention baselines on all 3 backbones.

VxTxDgRvRP.one_liner: Controlled study of understanding-generation synergy in native unified multimodal models at representation, task and system levels.
VxTxDgRvRP.problem: Unifying understanding and generation in one model does not guarantee that the two objectives reinforce each other; they may compete for capacity or merely coexist.
VxTxDgRvRP.method: They study native UMMs without pretrained vision priors at three levels: representation-level interaction with a task-decoupled architecture, task-level case studies of transfer, and a system-level comparison of an end-to-end UMM against a matched planner-executor pipeline.
VxTxDgRvRP.key_idea: Specialize conflicting visual computation in a task-decoupled architecture while keeping semantic interaction, so neither objective dominates the shared computation path.
VxTxDgRvRP.evidence: A controlled native setting without pretrained vision priors, three task-level case studies, and an end-to-end versus planner-executor comparison on tasks requiring both understanding and generation.

BOyTp7MiOV.one_liner: Shared-parameter model alternates between search-agent and critic roles, learning in-trajectory feedback through coupled online RL and offline preference optimization.
BOyTp7MiOV.problem: In long-horizon search, early directional errors get no immediate corrective signal and compound, and learnable feedback couples agent and critic, which must learn from outcome-confounded rollouts as failure patterns evolve.
BOyTp7MiOV.method: CAFE initializes feedback-conditioned recovery from trajectories built around the base agent's own failures. Online RL uses a prompt-level call-skip success gap to shape request returns plus feedback-aware advantage shaping, while offline preference optimization learns feedback from matched successful and unsuccessful trajectories.
BOyTp7MiOV.key_idea: Train one shared model as both search agent and critic, shaping feedback-request returns by the call-versus-skip success gap and reweighting token advantages around feedback.
BOyTp7MiOV.evidence: Seven agentic search benchmarks (comparison results truncated in the abstract).

kLBd76smel.one_liner: Adds a multi-view point-tracking head on attention features to supervise camera-conditioned 4D video diffusion for novel-view video.
kLBd76smel.problem: Explicit-3D methods give inaccurate geometry for dynamic objects in monocular video, while camera-conditioning-only 4D video diffusion models struggle to preserve geometric and motion consistency with the reference video.
kLBd76smel.method: Routes features from specific attention layers of a 4D video diffusion model into an auxiliary multi-view tracking head and jointly trains the diffusion model with a point-tracking objective.
kLBd76smel.key_idea: Specific attention layers encode cross-view, cross-time correspondence; an auxiliary multi-view tracking head trained jointly strengthens those correspondences as geometric and motion supervision.
kLBd76smel.evidence: The abstract reports an analysis of attention layers in 4D video diffusion models and states it improves existing models; datasets, models and settings are not stated in the visible (truncated) abstract.

hoMrocA56C.one_liner: Conditions image retrieval, box refinement and temporal memory on 4D radar evidence for radar-camera 3D object detection.
hoMrocA56C.problem: Radar-camera detectors solve where to align modalities but leave implicit whether a piece of image, radar or memory evidence actually supports the current object hypothesis.
hoMrocA56C.method: Hypothesis-conditioned evidence grounding with three modules: Anchor-Grounded Semantic Retrieval conditions deformable image retrieval on anchor-consistent radar support, Geometry-Consistent Anchor Refinement attentively aggregates associated returns, and Doppler-Verified Correspondence replaces history only when current radial motion contradicts it.
hoMrocA56C.key_idea: Evidence is filtered or conditioned by the evolving 3D object state before updating each query, separating candidate access from evidence use.
hoMrocA56C.evidence: Evaluated on OmniHD-Scenes, ManTruckScenes and the TJ4DRadSet test comparison, plus mechanism-targeted evaluations such as strict AP in projected-occlusion bins.
hoMrocA56C.claimed_gains: Improves the strongest compared method by 3.82 mAP and 6.82 ODS on OmniHD-Scenes and by 6.82 mAP and 9.22 NDS on ManTruckScenes, and leads the listed methods on the TJ4DRadSet test comparison.

lf5k0V2l9r.one_liner: Merges multi-teacher capability distillation and few-step distillation into one on-policy stage for text-to-image diffusion students.
lf5k0V2l9r.problem: Capabilities and few-step sampling are built in separate stages, so every full-step model evaluated scores lower once compressed and the second stage cannot start until the first finishes.
lf5k0V2l9r.method: One student acquires all capabilities while learning few-step sampling, supervised by frozen specialists on the states its own rollout visits, and its velocity is regressed on the low-noise part of the rollout, motivated by a KL decomposition. A variant lowers unwanted rendering of prompt words as text.
lf5k0V2l9r.key_idea: Frozen specialist teachers supervise a few-step student on its own rollout states, with velocity regression restricted to the low-noise part of the rollout.
lf5k0V2l9r.evidence: Evaluated on SD3.5-Medium and FLUX.1-dev across instruction following, text rendering, image quality and human preference.
lf5k0V2l9r.claimed_gains: Attains the highest normalized average score among the four-step methods compared on both architectures, exceeds the forty-step Flow-OPD model, and on SD3.5-Medium trains with about 37% (abstract truncated).

BBn3Q6dIzT.one_liner: Randomly masks historical value tokens in training and samples historical KV tokens per head at inference for long-video generation.
BBn3Q6dIzT.problem: Autoregressive video generators rely on previously generated history for continuity, but that history can carry errors into later predictions.
BBn3Q6dIzT.method: History Dropout varies historical value masks across denoising steps during training while keeping all keys for attention normalization, with inverse-retention scaling; at inference each attention head independently samples historical key-value tokens, always keeping sink and current-chunk tokens.
BBn3Q6dIzT.key_idea: Training masks historical values without changing the softmax denominator; inference lets each head sample a subset of historical KV tokens, shortening attention inputs.
BBn3Q6dIzT.evidence: Applied to Self Forcing, Causal Forcing and LongLive, evaluated at 60 and 240 seconds, with latency measured on a single NVIDIA H20 GPU.
BBn3Q6dIzT.claimed_gains: Improves visual quality and dynamics at both 60 and 240 seconds, while inference latency decreases from 0.72 to 0.64 seconds on a single NVIDIA H20 GPU.

M752QnEbXC.one_liner: On-policy context distillation that alternates training a policy on rubric-derived experience and training it to generate better rubrics.
M752QnEbXC.problem: Scalar rewards in rubric-based RL discard language feedback, and fixed pre-defined context for context distillation becomes suboptimal as the policy improves.
M752QnEbXC.method: CoPE improves one policy's task performance and rubric generation together: a frozen feedback model uses the policy's evolving rubrics to extract adaptive experience, then one phase trains the policy with that experience as extra context and the other trains it as rubric generator, iterated.
M752QnEbXC.key_idea: The same policy alternately distills experience-as-context into its parameters and learns to write the rubrics from which a frozen feedback model extracts that experience.
M752QnEbXC.evidence: Evaluated on open-ended generation tasks and evaluation ability, where the policy generates rubrics to choose the preferred response; specific datasets and models are not stated.
M752QnEbXC.claimed_gains: Outperforms scalar reward RL and previous experience learning approaches; no numbers stated.

MOLTwuUqhX.one_liner: Adapts a pretrained image-to-3D model to jointly generate hand-object geometry as a scaffold, then recovers separate assets.
MOLTwuUqhX.problem: Existing monocular hand-object reconstruction either makes limited use of object-centric image-to-3D priors or defers hand-object placement to test-time alignment optimization.
MOLTwuUqhX.method: JIGAR's Joint Interaction Generation stage generates hand-object geometry jointly as an interaction scaffold, which guides separate asset recovery through in-place object regeneration and parametric hand recovery.
MOLTwuUqhX.key_idea: Generate hand and object in one shared geometry so the generative prior sets relative pose and scale, then regenerate the object in place around the hand.
MOLTwuUqhX.evidence: Evaluated on SHOWMe, HOT3D and HO-Cap against baselines.
MOLTwuUqhX.claimed_gains: Outperforms all evaluated baselines in object and interaction reconstruction, reducing hand-aligned object Chamfer distance by 42.3-63.2% relative to the strongest evaluated baseline.

IKUjfAknOl.one_liner: Autoresearch loop that tests falsifiable hypotheses on agent trajectories to build a graph of vulnerability concepts for red-teaming agents.
IKUjfAknOl.problem: Automatic red-teaming methods retain successful attacks but not why they succeeded, so after a failed reuse testers cannot tell whether the weakness is gone or the attack no longer fits.
IKUjfAknOl.method: Agent Hacks Agents retains vulnerability concepts, each stating why an attack succeeds, its enabling condition and the evidence that would refute it, discovered by a Karpathy-style autoresearch loop; repeatedly confirmed concepts enter a vulnerability concept graph linking related weaknesses.
IKUjfAknOl.key_idea: Store falsifiable vulnerability concepts (why, enabling condition, refuting evidence) instead of raw successful attacks, and link confirmed concepts in a graph for reuse and coordination.
IKUjfAknOl.evidence: Tested across 18 settings of three scenarios, three victim models and two agents, with held-out instances and reuse on new victims, scenarios and harnesses; concepts fall into eight families.
IKUjfAknOl.claimed_gains: On held-out instances the concepts reach a 47.0% attack success rate versus 32.8% for the strongest baseline, which uses more discovery queries.

KwJvnZFdu6.one_liner: Topology-based language-conditioned navigation grounding retrieval in trajectory context, map compression in semantics, and navigation in monocular-depth geometry.
KwJvnZFdu6.problem: At long range, visual appearance is an unreliable proxy for task relevance: similar landmarks confuse retrieval, redundant observations can be instruction-critical, and waypoint errors accumulate.
KwJvnZFdu6.method: GRONav grounds target retrieval in action and trajectory context, map compression in semantic composition, and navigation in geometric structure distilled from monocular depth.
KwJvnZFdu6.key_idea: Make visual evidence decision-specific: retrieval, map compression and navigation each use their own grounding signal instead of raw appearance.
KwJvnZFdu6.evidence: Experiments in CARLA and on a real quadrupedal robot against strong baselines, measuring retrieval accuracy, navigation success, robustness and inference latency.
KwJvnZFdu6.claimed_gains: 91.7% target retrieval accuracy, 68.0% smaller topology, and more than 25.0% better real-world navigation performance on 60-200m tasks.

trytZidnme.one_liner: Adapts pretrained pixel-space diffusion to real-world super-resolution with wavelet discrimination, contrastive self-distillation and selective LoRA pruning.
trytZidnme.problem: Latent diffusion super-resolution loses fidelity to VAE compression, and pixel-space diffusion models adapted to Real-ISR suffer patch boundary artifacts and degraded generative capability.
trytZidnme.method: A Cross-Scale Wavelet Discriminator and Mixup Contrastive Self-Distillation suppress unrealistic high-frequency periodic components and regularize intermediate representations, and Selective LoRA Pruning prunes LoRA layers adaptively to restore generative capability.
trytZidnme.key_idea: Penalize periodic high-frequency patch artifacts with a wavelet discriminator, and prune LoRA layers according to their uneven generation-fidelity trade-off.
trytZidnme.evidence: Experiments compare against latent-space methods on restoration accuracy and perceptual quality; datasets and metrics are not stated in the visible abstract.
trytZidnme.claimed_gains: Outperforms existing latent-space methods 'by a large margin' on restoration accuracy and perceptual quality; no numbers stated.

3gnF7aPtNF.one_liner: Audio autoencoder pairing a learned diffusion-prior rate model with a flow-matching waveform decoder for high-compression latents.
3gnF7aPtNF.problem: A fixed Gaussian posterior-KL spends limited capacity on distribution matching, and high compression leaves recording-specific acoustics underdetermined for deterministic waveform decoders.
3gnF7aPtNF.method: AuDiAE replaces the fixed Gaussian reference with a learned marginal diffusion prior (plus a conditional counterpart) and decodes with a flow-matching decoder trained to predict the clean waveform, both through a common encoder representation.
3gnF7aPtNF.key_idea: A learned diffusion density replaces the fixed Gaussian in the KL term, and a flow-matching decoder models residual variation, valuing latents by reduction in denoising risk.
3gnF7aPtNF.evidence: Evaluated at 2048x compression and a high-compression variant AuDiAE-H at 4096x on audio reconstruction and text-to-audio generation (abstract truncated).

t8Pg5VElI5.one_liner: Reconstructs executable terminal environments by replaying file operations from agent trajectories, then re-queries them for new tasks.
t8Pg5VElI5.problem: Terminal-agent trajectories have accumulated at scale, but realistic executable environments, which post-training needs for verifiable tasks and execution feedback, remain scarce.
t8Pg5VElI5.method: Replays recorded file operations to restore each file before the agent modified it, uses a completion agent to supply missing files and dependencies, then reconstructs the original task and synthesizes new ones on the recovered workspace, scaled in breadth and depth.
t8Pg5VElI5.key_idea: Tool-execution history in a trajectory exposes the environment's structure, so replaying recorded file operations plus agent-completed gaps recovers a reusable workspace.
t8Pg5VElI5.evidence: Not stated in the visible abstract, which is truncated before the experiments.

WsLUWEDwZr.one_liner: Learns data moments with neural networks via polynomial-projection diffusion denoisers, yielding the Amortized Frechet Distance loss.
WsLUWEDwZr.problem: FD-loss relies on explicit marginal moment calculations rather than learned conditional moments.
WsLUWEDwZr.method: Casts diffusion denoisers as polynomial projections so an n-th degree projection identifies data moments up to order n+1, then instantiates the affine case as the AMFD loss, trained with an alternating, matrix-free optimization pipeline.
WsLUWEDwZr.key_idea: A neural network amortizes the data moments through polynomial-projection denoisers, replacing exact statistics in the Frechet distance loss with learned conditional moments.
WsLUWEDwZr.evidence: ImageNet one-step generation, post-training on representation features, exploration in native generative spaces, and text-to-image scaling against a FLUX.2 [klein] 4B teacher.
WsLUWEDwZr.claimed_gains: Substantially surpasses the FD-loss baseline on the FDr^6 metric, achieves superior one-step generation on ImageNet, and the one-step text-to-image model outperforms the FLUX.2 [klein] 4B teacher on a metric cut off in the abstract.

w9AtxUbfFB.one_liner: Distills looped shallow-layer refinement from an online stop-gradient teacher into single-pass block diffusion language models.
w9AtxUbfFB.problem: Converting an autoregressive LLM into a block diffusion LM creates an information-flow bottleneck: masked token states stabilize prematurely in shallow layers, with overconfident predictions rarely consistent with the final output.
w9AtxUbfFB.method: During training, an online stop-gradient teacher built from the student's current weights loops selected shallow layers to refine masked states, and that refinement is distilled into the original single-pass model.
w9AtxUbfFB.key_idea: Loop selected shallow layers in a stop-gradient teacher copy so masked states absorb known context, then distill that loop into the unchanged single-pass student.
w9AtxUbfFB.evidence: Evaluated across 13 benchmarks on GLM-4.7-Flash and Qwen-30B-A3B-2507.
w9AtxUbfFB.claimed_gains: Improves average accuracy on GLM-4.7-Flash and Qwen-30B-A3B-2507 by 2.05 (abstract truncated) and boosts decoding throughput; other numbers not stated.

10fWGFFHX7.one_liner: Hybrid KV cache compression for autoregressive video diffusion: static head pruning plus segment-similarity dynamic pruning.
10fWGFFHX7.problem: Autoregressive video diffusion models retain largely redundant KV caches for historical frames, creating attention and memory overhead that limits scalability.
10fWGFFHX7.method: Attention heads are split by head-wise functional specialization into static heads (chunk transitions, intra-frame fidelity) and dynamic heads (inter-frame motion, consistency); static heads get structured static pruning and dynamic heads get pruning based on segment-wise similarity.
10fWGFFHX7.key_idea: Heads keep stable functional roles across samples and denoising steps, so static heads use fixed structured pruning while dynamic heads prune by segment-wise similarity.
10fWGFFHX7.evidence: Empirical study of head-wise attention patterns in mainstream autoregressive diffusion models such as Self Forcing, with throughput measured on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU.
10fWGFFHX7.claimed_gains: Compresses 53%-73% of the KV cache, achieves 29 FPS on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU with 30% peak cache memory reduction, and delivers up to 1.35x (abstract truncated).

2J9If8LIY9.one_liner: Permutation-space framework linking ranking metrics to convex calibration dimension and what score-based gradients can recover.
2J9If8LIY9.problem: Learning-to-rank optimizes item scores while evaluation metrics assess permutations, so it is unclear whether score-based optimization captures what a metric requires.
2J9If8LIY9.method: They represent ranking metrics as linear utilities over permutation distributions and use utility differences between permutations, with the Plackett-Luce model linking scores to permutation probabilities, to analyze convex calibration and what expected gradients and Hessians recover.
2J9If8LIY9.key_idea: Treat each ranking metric as a linear utility over permutation distributions and test whether Plackett-Luce expected gradients and Hessians recover its utility differences.
2J9If8LIY9.evidence: Theorems under arbitrary joint distributions on the complete binary relevance space for normalized AUC, binary NDCG, average precision, reciprocal rank, and cascades; experiments are not stated in the available abstract.
2J9If8LIY9.claimed_gains: Exact convex calibration dimensions grow linearly for normalized AUC and binary NDCG with nonconstant discounts, quadratically for AP, and exponentially for RR and homogeneous cascades with positive parameters.

hLTtjANO5B.one_liner: Organizes latent action tokens on an observation-aligned 2D grid with locality-biased attention to improve policies and world models.
hLTtjANO5B.problem: Latent action models use spatially unstructured tokens, leaving their correspondence to the locations of visual changes implicit and limiting reuse of local transition content across positions.
hLTtjANO5B.method: SpatialLAM places latent actions on a 2D grid aligned with the observation plane and uses locality-biased attention to ground each token in a consistent visual neighborhood. It is evaluated in policy learning and world modeling under matched data, optimization and latent capacity.
hLTtjANO5B.key_idea: Give each latent action token a fixed grid position aligned with the image and restrict its attention to a local visual neighborhood, so tokens map to consistent regions.
hLTtjANO5B.evidence: Policy learning on LIBERO-Long, out-of-distribution LIBERO-Plus and three real-world manipulation tasks, and world modeling on Something-Something V2 and Bridge V2, under matched data, optimization and latent capacity.
hLTtjANO5B.claimed_gains: Policy success rises from 76.8% to 83.0% on LIBERO-Long, 64.6% to 70.7% on LIBERO-Plus and 45.0% to 66.7% on three real-world tasks, and world-model FVD falls by 16.9% on Something-Something V2 and 10.9% on Bridge V2.

kruWwfGC0J.one_liner: Generates 3D Gaussian driving scenes in feed-forward reconstruction space, conditioned on metric layouts via decoded calibration and decoding supervision.
kruWwfGC0J.problem: Video models control driving layouts only in 2D and lack consistent geometry across frames and views, Gaussian scenes built from generated videos can mismatch generated appearance, and reconstruction-space methods need the frozen decoder's scale and FOVs to condition on metric layouts.
kruWwfGC0J.method: Generates in reconstruction space with scene-specific scale and decoder fields of view; two-stage layout control first aligns content with projected HD maps and actor tracks, then uses decoded calibration to encode metric layouts as reconstruction rays and depths. Hierarchical Decoding Supervision (HDS) backpropagates feature, geometry and image errors through the frozen decoder.
kruWwfGC0J.key_idea: Generate in a frozen reconstruction decoder's state space, encode metric layouts as rays and depths from decoded calibration, and supervise through the decoder.
kruWwfGC0J.evidence: Waymo driving data compared against InfiniCube, plus an evaluation under physical cameras using LiDAR depth error.
kruWwfGC0J.claimed_gains: On Waymo, DriveReGen reduces FVD by 58.0% and improves lane F1 by 3.77 percentage points over InfiniCube, and under physical cameras its road/actor LiDAR AbsRel is 17.0% lower.

j71zUcE8gz.one_liner: Observer-centric RoPE places 3D visual tokens in the observer's BEV frame, with learnable observer anchors, for situated question answering.
j71zUcE8gz.problem: Existing situated question answering approaches are largely insensitive to situation descriptions and underuse the observer's position and orientation.
j71zUcE8gz.method: OC-SQA projects the 3D locations of visual tokens onto a shared bird's-eye-view plane and transforms them into the observer's reference frame for rotary position embedding (OC-RoPE), and adds a learnable observer anchor at the head of each frame's visual tokens to mark the observer's origin.
j71zUcE8gz.key_idea: Rotary positions are computed from BEV-projected token locations expressed in the observer's pose frame, with a learnable anchor token marking the observer origin.
j71zUcE8gz.evidence: Experiments on SQA3D, Real3DQA, and MSQA, with analyses showing greater reliance on visual tokens relevant to the situated questions.

F6JfzMBdJT.one_liner: Decentralized solver for Wasserstein barycenters with movable support locations, using MM updates and gossip aggregation over graphs.
F6JfzMBdJT.problem: Existing decentralized Wasserstein barycenter methods fix a shared support and optimize only weights, so the support cannot adapt to the geometry of the input measures.
F6JfzMBdJT.method: They propose a decentralized free-support solver that learns continuously movable support locations over arbitrary connected undirected graphs without sharing local input measures. Guarantees are given under fully connected aggregation and under gossip-based aggregation.
F6JfzMBdJT.key_idea: Learn movable support locations through decentralized MM updates aggregated by full or gossip communication, with Clarke-stationarity guarantees.
F6JfzMBdJT.evidence: Theory under fully connected and gossip aggregation (monotone MM descent, best-iterate Clarke stationarity, topology-dependent disagreement bounds), plus experiments on synthetic measures, image distributions, and 3D point clouds.
F6JfzMBdJT.claimed_gains: The TL;DR states resource costs are cut by up to 3 orders while barycenter quality improves substantially; the abstract gives no further numbers.

aDHQ65QPxg.one_liner: Breathe alternates exploration with deliberate challenges that remove, replace or simplify inherited components in LLM-driven wireless algorithm discovery.
aDHQ65QPxg.problem: LLM discovery agents accumulate and tune algorithm components rather than questioning whether previously accepted components are still necessary, while coupled components make earlier feedback outdated.
aDHQ65QPxg.method: Breathe is a wireless algorithm discovery framework that explicitly coordinates when an agent explores new designs and when it challenges the current structure by removing, replacing or simplifying inherited components. Part of the experimental budget is allocated to such challenges.
aDHQ65QPxg.key_idea: Reserve part of the experiment budget for explicit challenges to accepted components, scheduled against exploration, so stale or harmful components get removed.
aDHQ65QPxg.evidence: A benchmark of current LLM-based discovery agents on four wireless algorithm design tasks, with Breathe compared against a state-of-the-art agent system across all tasks.

jNpyhtMWWL.one_liner: Prediction-assisted deterministic online allocation achieving 19/30-PROP1, plus impossibility results for alpha-PROPk against adaptive adversaries.
jNpyhtMWWL.problem: In online fair division of indivisible items, it was open whether any positive PROPk guarantee is possible against adaptive adversaries and whether the 1/n dependence of the best guarantee with a maximum-value prediction is necessary.
jNpyhtMWWL.method: Proves that for every n>=2 agents, fixed k>=1 and alpha in (0,1] no online algorithm guarantees alpha-PROPk against an adaptive adversary, extends this to many envy-, proportionality- and share-based notions and to chores, and gives a deterministic 19/30-PROP1 algorithm using a prediction of each agent's maximum item value that does not need the total number of goods.
jNpyhtMWWL.key_idea: Use a prediction of each agent's maximum item value as lightweight future information to get an n-independent constant PROP1 guarantee in an otherwise impossible adaptive-adversary setting.
jNpyhtMWWL.evidence: Proof-based: impossibility theorems and algorithm guarantees; no empirical evaluation is stated.
jNpyhtMWWL.claimed_gains: A deterministic 19/30-PROP1 guarantee against adaptive adversaries (previous best 1/n-PROP1), improving to max{19/30, n/(n+kappa)} given an upper bound kappa in [2, n] on the number of agents who value any good positively.

1V3066nDJF.one_liner: CMC resolves updates to current relations before traversing them from question entities, returning original records to the answer model.
1V3066nDJF.problem: In agent memory, updating one relation can redirect a multi-hop question to records about an entity absent from the question, so selecting evidence before resolving updates fails.
1V3066nDJF.method: Before seeing a question, CMC uses a language model to identify relations in the history and record where each was stated, applies later updates to get current relations, follows them from entities named in the question, and passes the corresponding original records to the answer model in one call. The paper also introduces MQuAKE-MemStream, a dataset of ordered memory streams built from MQuAKE-Remastered counterfactual cases.
1V3066nDJF.key_idea: Resolve updates into current relations first, then traverse those relations from question entities so the current state determines which original records are read.
1V3066nDJF.evidence: Multi-hop accuracy on FactConsolidation, with an ablation that holds extracted relations and the answer model fixed while selecting evidence before resolving updates.
1V3066nDJF.claimed_gains: Reaches 78.25% overall multi-hop accuracy and 61.0% at 262K on FactConsolidation, while selecting evidence before resolving updates reduces multi-hop accuracy to 21.50%.

k497d9PXFm.one_liner: Distills dual-frequency structure from an RGB-IR teacher and modulates RGB and IR features by cross-modal frequency consistency.
k497d9PXFm.problem: RGB-centric vision-language models model infrared semantics poorly, hindering integration of IR cues into query-conditioned representations for RGB-T visual grounding.
k497d9PXFm.method: Dual-Frequency Spectral Distillation (DFSD) transfers structure from a pretrained RGB-IR teacher by aligning query-conditioned low-frequency target-affinity relations and high-frequency RGB-IR correspondences. Spectral Alignment-Guided Representation Modulation (SARM) uses local cross-modal frequency consistency to modulate shared and complementary responses, producing frequency tokens for grounding.
k497d9PXFm.key_idea: Low frequencies carry coarse query-relevant structure and high frequencies carry fine local detail, so distill each band separately from an RGB-IR teacher and modulate fusion by local frequency consistency.
k497d9PXFm.evidence: Experiments on RefFLIR, RefM3FD, and RefMFAD (abstract truncated before results).
k497d9PXFm.claimed_gains: Reports leading grounding performance on RefFLIR, RefM3FD, and RefMFAD; no numbers visible in the truncated abstract.

OllKu9vgU9.one_liner: One small module per data source in parallel with MLPs, trained to self-gate so unlearning needs no router.
OllKu9vgU9.problem: Unlearning by construction confines each data source to a separate module but needs a router and source labels at inference, which adds deployment overhead.
OllKu9vgU9.method: MUSR places one small module per source in parallel with the MLP layers and passes every input through all of them. During training each module learns to contribute on its own source and stay near zero on every other, so inference is a sum of module outputs.
OllKu9vgU9.key_idea: Train per-source parallel modules to output near zero on other sources, so they gate themselves and inference sums all module outputs without routing.
OllKu9vgU9.evidence: Four language models in pretraining and fine-tuning setups, compared against modular baselines, plus repeated deletion requests and source addition (abstract truncated).
OllKu9vgU9.claimed_gains: Matches the removal performance of the modular baselines while retaining 99.7% of pre-unlearning model utility on average.

WTmChZA9OO.one_liner: Long-video QA search guided by a question-agnostic temporal world model that predicts unread visual features in latent space.
WTmChZA9OO.problem: Finding decisive evidence in a long video requires processing many irrelevant frames, and frame selection or relevance-guided search ignores the temporal context that sparse observations give for predicting unread features.
WTmChZA9OO.method: A question-agnostic temporal world model predicts unread visual features so relevance can be assessed before real acquisition. New observations refine the predicted timeline and give relevance corrections that persist across search rounds, replacing expensive decoding and encoding with latent computation.
WTmChZA9OO.key_idea: Predict features of unread video segments with a temporal world model to score relevance before acquiring frames, refining predictions as observations arrive.
WTmChZA9OO.evidence: Five long-video QA benchmarks with a shared answerer, compared against strong frame-selection baselines.
WTmChZA9OO.claimed_gains: Highest mean accuracy on three of five long-video QA benchmarks and up to 5.1x evidence-acquisition speedups over strong frame-selection baselines.

9GDStxR3kP.one_liner: Diagnostic study showing sequential local repair in diffusion LLMs yields correlated candidates with lower answer coverage than independent sampling.
9GDStxR3kP.problem: Additional repair rounds in diffusion LLMs give limited gains, and it is unclear whether successive repair candidates explore distinct answer states.
9GDStxR3kP.method: Combines answer-level metrics (pairwise agreement, unique-answer counts, oracle pass@k, correction and regression rates), hyperparameter sweeps, and remasking interventions across four dLLMs and three verifiable tasks to characterize inter-trajectory dependence.
9GDStxR3kP.key_idea: Compares sequential remask-and-regenerate repair chains with independent sampling on answer agreement and oracle pass@k, locating the coverage gap in dependence between successive states of one chain.
9GDStxR3kP.evidence: Four dLLMs and three verifiable tasks; the gap persists when repair uses the independent sampler's blockwise kernel and denoising budget, and is not detected when states are pooled across independently initialized chains.
9GDStxR3kP.claimed_gains: not stated; this is a diagnostic study and the visible abstract gives no numeric results.

12OrE4miLg.one_liner: Selects multi-reward DiffusionNFT targets by Nash bargaining under a velocity-field displacement budget, using reward covariance and a field Gram matrix.
12OrE4miLg.problem: Fixed reward weights or balanced parameter gradients are incomplete for DiffusionNFT, where a reward vector must become a scalar optimality target and an attractive target may require a large change to the forward velocity field.
12OrE4miLg.method: For the linear optimality family o_a = r_0 + a^T R, the exact distribution-level reward gain is C a / r_0 (C is the covariance of centered rewards) and the population-optimal velocity displacement is 4 a^T M a / beta^2 for an NFT-native field Gram matrix M. FCB-NFT solves a small convex program maximizing Nash reward surplus under a displacement budget and valid-optimality constraints, with a finite-sample conservative estimator of M.
12OrE4miLg.key_idea: Choose the optimality weight vector by Nash bargaining over reward gains predicted from reward covariance, constrained by a velocity-field displacement measured with an NFT-native Gram matrix.
12OrE4miLg.evidence: Derivations of exact reward-gain and displacement formulas for the linear optimality family; the empirical setup is cut off in the visible abstract.

tSpuyBaWWf.one_liner: Displacement Matching regresses posterior-mean displacement in a few-step generator's clean-prediction space, unifying reward alignment and distillation.
tSpuyBaWWf.problem: Post-training few-step generators is hard because the deployed deterministic sampler lacks a stochastic transition likelihood for policy gradients, and reward alignment and distillation lack a unified formulation.
tSpuyBaWWf.method: Both forms of supervision are expressed as multiplicative tilts of the generator's terminal distribution; the tilt shifts clean-sample posterior means at each noise level, defining a displacement that DM learns as an additive prediction update. The generator's posterior mean is estimated separately from re-noised terminal samples.
tSpuyBaWWf.key_idea: Learn the posterior-mean displacement induced by a terminal-distribution tilt as an additive update to the clean prediction, via one regression that needs no trajectory likelihoods.
tSpuyBaWWf.evidence: A population analysis establishing first-order reward improvement up to an explicit finite-step residual and a unique teacher fixed point for raw distillation; the experimental results are cut off in the abstract.

thZYINSFH8.one_liner: Pretrains VLA policies on language-action pairs without vision, using 33K atomic action-segment episodes derived from existing demonstrations.
thZYINSFH8.problem: Dense visual-action supervision dominates the sparse language-action signal in VLA pretraining, so policies rely on visual shortcuts and are sensitive to visual variations.
thZYINSFH8.method: LA4VLA decomposes expert trajectories into atomic action segments paired with low-level action descriptions, yielding the LA-33K dataset, and trains LA4VLA-1B, a 1B-parameter VLA. It compares LA-only pretraining, sequential LA-to-VLA pretraining, and mixed LA-VLA pretraining.
thZYINSFH8.key_idea: Pretrain on language-conditioned action segments with no visual input so the policy learns reusable language-to-action priors before or alongside visual training.
thZYINSFH8.evidence: Simulation and real-world tasks comparing LA-pretrained policies against baselines; the abstract is truncated before the results.

FCnWjmOlAg.one_liner: Memory architecture for LLM agents that gates untrusted values, with two Lean 4-checked integrity theorems and community endorsements.
FCnWjmOlAg.problem: Persistent agent memory is an undefended surface for injection and poisoning, and the same risk limits memory sharing among agents.
FCnWjmOlAg.method: PerMIT mediates the release and use of untrusted environment-derived values through a finite memory interface while preserving agent-driven multi-turn planning and tool choice, trusting only user-typed inputs and values confirmed at a gate. Each confirmation is a logged verdict on exact content, so endorsements accumulate across users and sufficiently endorsed items become community-confirmed.
FCnWjmOlAg.key_idea: Route environment-derived memory through a confirmation gate so every attack reduces to one logged, auditable decision, and accumulate endorsements across users.
FCnWjmOlAg.evidence: Two integrity theorems machine-checked in Lean 4, an evaluation on Trojan Hippo, and a co-scaling property proved under explicit assumptions and corroborated in simulation (abstract truncated).
FCnWjmOlAg.claimed_gains: Zero observed attack success on Trojan Hippo with self-verification and lightweight verifiers.

6zSuqyB4a9.one_liner: Training-free diffusion-LLM sampler ranking candidate decoding transitions by future uncertainty reduction plus a sequential-versus-factorized joint-compatibility signal.
6zSuqyB4a9.problem: Diffusion LLMs' factorized parallel predictions can produce jointly incompatible tokens even when each is confident, and existing trajectory selection leaves unexamined how decoding choices reshape the dependency structure later updates face.
6zSuqyB4a9.method: Derives an information-theoretic identity linking current and expected residual factorization costs to the information revealed tokens give about remaining positions. FACTS then ranks candidate transitions by combining future uncertainty reduction with a joint-compatibility signal from comparing sequential and factorized scores of the same proposed tokens.
6zSuqyB4a9.key_idea: Rank candidate decoding transitions by expected future uncertainty reduction plus the gap between sequential and factorized scores of the same proposed tokens.
6zSuqyB4a9.evidence: Experiments on Dream and LLaDA across mathematical reasoning and code generation.
6zSuqyB4a9.claimed_gains: not stated (the abstract only says FACTS is particularly effective under wider parallel decoding).

dVXFFMVuTo.one_liner: Skill-level dataset and benchmark from 50 BEHAVIOR-1K activities for evaluating VLA policies on long-horizon mobile manipulation.
dVXFFMVuTo.problem: Long-horizon mobile manipulation skills are hard to learn and evaluate because similar observations make skill selection ambiguous, inherited start states deviate from demonstrations, and task-level metrics hide per-skill failures.
dVXFFMVuTo.method: ManiUnit pairs each of 137,899 segments (21 skill types, 417 subtasks) with an explicit subtask instruction, measures sensitivity to perturbed starting base position or joint configuration, and restores intermediate simulator states with local success conditions so each skill is evaluated without running preceding stages. The benchmark has 1,260 test instances.
dVXFFMVuTo.key_idea: Each skill is evaluated in isolation by restoring intermediate simulator states with local success conditions, and paired with explicit subtask instructions to remove skill ambiguity.
dVXFFMVuTo.evidence: Evaluations of representative vision-language-action policies on the benchmark, including starting-state perturbation tests.

vSqsA99XH4.one_liner: Optimizer post-update step that projects weights to the nearest point whose histogram matches a zero-mean Gaussian, suppressing quantization oscillation.
vSqsA99XH4.problem: Rounding-boundary weight oscillation adds noise and slows convergence in quantization-aware pre-training, and existing fixes add hyperparameters or memory overhead or do not consistently improve accuracy.
vSqsA99XH4.method: CEWT is a hyperparameter-free, memory-overhead-free post-update step that projects weights to the nearest point in weight space whose empirical distribution matches a zero-mean Gaussian. It rests on the observation that many quantizers implicitly assume the data are permutations of zero-mean Gaussian samples, which fails during QAPT.
vSqsA99XH4.key_idea: Enforcing a zero-mean Gaussian empirical weight histogram as a hard constraint after each optimizer step restores the distribution assumption quantizers rely on, which suppresses oscillation.
vSqsA99XH4.evidence: Various combinations of quantizers and hypersphere optimizers in quantization-aware pre-training, measured by pre-training perplexity.
vSqsA99XH4.claimed_gains: Reduces pre-training perplexity by an average of 2.5 (the maximum is cut off in the abstract) at a geomean 4% increase in training time.

69eDEysdQF.one_liner: Visual Commission Bench of 600 tasks and V-Protocol, an agent that composes task, cognitive, and expression modules at inference time.
69eDEysdQF.problem: Existing evaluations examine specific capabilities and settings, so end-to-end completion of visual commissions that integrate source materials and dependent stages is less understood.
69eDEysdQF.method: VCB has 600 tasks across 12 categories and three tiers, scored with 5,039 requirement checks and separate visual quality ratings. V-Protocol composes task, cognitive, and expression modules that exchange structured intermediate artifacts under a shared harness that tracks artifact revisions and dependencies, manages tools, and checks completion.
69eDEysdQF.key_idea: Dynamically compose reusable task, cognitive, and expression modules that exchange structured artifacts, with a shared harness tracking artifact revisions and dependencies.
69eDEysdQF.evidence: VCB (600 tasks, 12 categories, three tiers, 5,039 requirement checks) and Mind-Bench, using the same controller and image generator as the agent baselines, including SCOPE.
69eDEysdQF.claimed_gains: V-Protocol reaches 69.0% strict task success on VCB versus 42.0% for SCOPE, and on Mind-Bench strict accuracy rises from 39.2% to 45.4%.

4oP2EJ1KSr.one_liner: Learned Langevin phase-space updates lifted to Lie algebraic summaries compose associatively, enabling parallel prefix-scan simulation of molecular dynamics.
4oP2EJ1KSr.problem: Long-horizon molecular dynamics by sequential force-driven Langevin integration is expensive, and learned approaches model empirical state transitions rather than the Langevin update itself.
4oP2EJ1KSr.method: TSL-Flow models underdamped Langevin dynamics through phase-space updates designed to preserve thermo-symplectic structure, lifting local stochastic updates into Lie algebraic summaries with an associative composition across time. A prefix-scan-compatible product then propagates trajectory segments in parallel.
4oP2EJ1KSr.key_idea: Represent each stochastic Langevin step as a Lie-algebraic summary whose associative product lets a prefix scan compose many steps in parallel while preserving thermo-symplectic structure.
4oP2EJ1KSr.evidence: Empirical evaluation on biomolecular benchmarks measuring coordinate fidelity, physical fidelity, and inference time; the benchmarks are not named in the abstract.
4oP2EJ1KSr.claimed_gains: Improves coordinate and physical fidelity across biomolecular benchmarks and achieves the lowest inference time; no numbers stated.

ubiZuUXpr6.one_liner: Learns a compact task-conditioned world representation by predicting future observation embeddings, shared with action decoding, without reconstructing pixels.
ubiZuUXpr6.problem: World action models gain behavioral priors by modeling future scenes, but predicting detailed futures in pixel or latent space is costly, and it is unclear what a WAM must learn to improve control.
